stories.title: Ken Skates praises ‘resilience’ of Connah’s Quay veterans’ hub
stories.summary: A Connah’s Quay veterans’ project that was told in 2022 it would end is still running, with its own café and veteran-led cleaning and gardening services. stories.title: Police ask people in south Flintshire to report places where they feel unsafe
stories.summary: Police are asking people in Mold, Buckley, Hawarden and Broughton to tell them about streets and public places where they feel unsafe. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team said it wants to identify “areas of concern” over the coming weeks. Reports can be made anonymously through StreetSafe, a service on the force’s website. stories.summary: A 38-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of murder after a body was found in a van which was on fire in Prestatyn. stories.title: Road closures and temporary lights across Flintshire this week
stories.summary: Lane closures on the A548 at Deeside Industrial Estate and three-way lights on Chester Road in Broughton are among the roadworks listed across Flintshire this week.
